responsibilities.description: Keeps bookings in an in-memory store. It gives each new booking a unique identifier and supports lookup by id, update, and listing all bookings.
responsibilities.name: Store and retrieve bookings

responsibilities.description: Keeps a secondary index from session id to that session's bookings so per-session reads are fast. The index stays in sync when bookings are created or replaced.
